items.source: Note that this property is ignored when maxInMemorySize is set to -1.

items.source: By default this is set to -1, meaning that there is no maximum.

items.source: Get the configured maximum in-memory size.

items.source: In default, non-streaming mode, this message reader stores the contents of parts smaller than maxInMemorySize in memory, and parts larger than that to a temporary file in fileStorageDirectory.
items.translation: 默认情况下，在非流式模式下，此消息读取器将小于 contents 的部分存储在内存中，而大于 maxInMemorySize 的部分则存储到临时文件中，该临时文件位于 fileStorageDirectory。

items.source: This reader can be provided to MultipartHttpMessageReader in order to aggregate all parts into a Map.
items.translation: 此读取器可提供给MultipartHttpMessageReader，以便将所有部分聚合到一个 Map 中。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this reader. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(elementType, null). The list may also exclude media types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此读取器支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canWrite(elementType, null) 进行保护。该列表也可能排除仅针对特定元素类型支持的媒体类型。或者，使用 HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。
